script_text: Stop, Taurus — Venus, your ruling planet, is drawing a boundary around your Earth element. On June 11, Venus in Taurus sits in your 1st House, while Mars in the 3rd House trines Saturn and Neptune in your 11th House. Jupiter in Cancer trines that 11th-House Saturn, turning a message or contact into proof. If single, a steady person enters through a text, class, sibling, or neighbor, but they move slowly. If attached, do not turn a schedule change into a loyalty test; your partner needs practical reassurance. In the 10th House, Pluto sextiles your Taurus Sun, so a senior person or client notices your reliability and opens leverage. The Sun in your 2nd House says name your rate before the meeting ends. Avoid lending money because Uranus in the 2nd House makes promises look shinier than paperwork. Subscribe so you don't miss what Venus reveals this week.
